data.body: Store survey on 2026-11-01 (5,671 tickets, in-process via rebar.list_tickets + det_operator_attested.ac_item_lines; detector = AC checkbox line not matched by _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE that contains [non-codebase] or [operator-attested] outside backtick spans).
